WITH store_product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey,
        st.StoreName,
        s.ProductKey,
        p.ProductName,
        sum(s.SalesAmount) AS product_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
    JOIN retail.DimStore st ON s.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY s.StoreKey, st.StoreName, s.ProductKey, p.ProductName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        StoreName,
        ProductKey,
        ProductName,
        product_sales,
        sum(product_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey) AS store_total_sales,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY product_sales DESC) AS product_rank
    FROM store_product_sales
)
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    product_rank,
    ProductKey,
    ProductName,
    round(product_sales, 2) AS product_sales,
    round(store_total_sales, 2) AS store_total_sales,
    round(product_sales * 100.0 / nullIf(store_total_sales, 0), 2) AS pct_of_store_sales
FROM ranked
WHERE product_rank <= 3
ORDER BY StoreKey, product_rank
